caption.text:
You don’t have to have everything figured out right now.

You don’t need a five-year plan. You don’t need to suddenly become a different person overnight. You don’t need to prove that you’re making perfect use of every day.

You’ve already made it through things you once thought would break you. There are versions of you from the past that would be relieved to know you made it this far.

I know it’s easy to look around and feel behind. To wonder if everyone else understands something you somehow missed. To think you should be doing more, becoming more, fixing more.

But maybe you’re allowed to be a work in progress without treating yourself like a problem.

Maybe your life isn’t late.

Maybe you’re just living through a chapter that doesn’t make much sense while you’re inside it.

You are still growing, even on the days that feel ordinary. You are still changing, even when it seems like nothing is happening. And you are allowed to trust that not every good thing has already happened.

There are conversations you haven’t had yet that will stay with you for years. There are people you haven’t met yet who will be grateful you came into their lives. There are moments waiting for you that would make all this worrying feel strangely distant.

You don’t have to force your future into existence.

Just keep showing up.

Keep being curious.

Keep giving yourself the same patience you would give someone you love.

You might be a lot closer to the life you’re hoping for than you realize. ✨
